subject: general
question: A and B start a business with capitals of Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 45,000. If the profit is divided in the ratio 2 : 3 , determine the ratio of the time periods of investment for A and B.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Capital Ratio (A : B) = 20,000 : 45,000 = 4 : 9

Profit Ratio (A : B) = 2 : 3

Time Ratio = (Profit Ratio) ÷ (Capital Ratio)

Time Ratio = (2/4) : (3/9) = 1/2 : 1/3 = 3 : 2

**∴ The correct answer is 3:2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment of A (C₁) = ₹20,000

Investment of B (C₂) = ₹45,000

Ratio of Profit (P₁ : P₂) = 2 : 3

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Capital × Time

⇒ P₁/P₂ = (C₁ × T₁) / (C₂ × T₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8fdd6d7c278746a57215a05a99eba2543ced636fa92437573f75ef823c46ddc.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 / 3 = (20,000 × T₁) / (45,000 × T₂)

⇒ 2 / 3 = (20 × T₁) / (45 × T₂)

⇒ 2 / 3 = (4 × T₁) / (9 × T₂)

⇒ T₁ / T₂ = (2 × 9) / (3 × 4)

⇒ T₁ / T₂ = 18 / 12

⇒ T₁ / T₂ = 3 / 2

**∴ The correct answer is 3:2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Partnership

When partners invest their capital for different time periods, the profit is distributed in the ratio of the product of their capital and time period (P = C × T).

Capital Calculation

If the profit ratio and time ratio are known, the capital ratio can be calculated as C₁ : C₂ = (P₁/T₁) : (P₂/T₂).

Working Partner vs Sleeping Partner

A working partner manages the business and may receive a fixed salary or extra profit percentage before the remaining profit is divided based on investment ratio.
